title: The Low Complexity Domain of the FUS RNA Binding Protein Self-assembles via the Mutually Exclusive Use of Two Distinct Cross-β Cores
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FUS RNA结合蛋白低复杂度结构域通过交叉β核心自组装与相分离，聚焦蛋白自身聚集而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The low complexity (LC) domain of the fused in sarcoma (FUS) RNA binding protein self-associates in a manner causing phase separation from an aqueous environment. Incubation of the FUS LC domain under physiologically normal conditions of salt and pH leads to rapid formation of liquid-like droplets that mature into a gel-like state. Both examples of phase separation have enabled reductionist biochemical assays allowing discovery of an N-terminal region of 56 residues that assembles into a labile, cross-β structure. Here we provide evidence of a non-overlapping, C-terminal region of the FUS LC domain that also forms specific cross-β interactions. We propose that biologic function of the FUS LC domain may operate via the mutually exclusive use of these N- and C-terminal cross-β cores. Neurodegenerative disease-causing mutations in the FUS LC domain are shown to imbalance the two cross-β cores, offering an unanticipated concept of LC domain function and dysfunction. Significance Statement Single amino acid changes causative of neurologic disease often map to the cross-β forming regions of low complexity (LC) domains. All such mutations studied to date lead to enhanced avidity of cross-β interactions. The LC domain of the fused in sarcoma (FUS) RNA binding protein contains three different regions that are capable of forming labile cross-β interactions. Here we describe the perplexing effect of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)-causing mutations localized to the LC domain of FUS to substantially weaken its ability to form one of its three cross-β interactions. An understanding of how these mutations abet uncontrolled polymerization of the FUS LC domain may represent an important clue as to how LC domains achieve their proper biological function.
abstract_zh: 肉瘤融合（FUS）RNA结合蛋白的低复杂度（LC）结构域以某种方式自结合，导致其从水环境中发生相分离。在生理正常的盐浓度和pH条件下孵育FUS LC结构域，会迅速形成液滴状结构，并成熟为凝胶状状态。这两种相分离实例使得还原论生化分析成为可能，从而发现了一个由56个残基组成的N端区域，该区域组装成不稳定的交叉β结构。在此，我们提供了FUS LC结构域中一个非重叠的C端区域的证据，该区域也形成特定的交叉β相互作用。我们提出，FUS LC结构域的生物学功能可能通过N端和C端交叉β核心的互斥使用来实现。研究表明，导致神经退行性疾病的FUS LC结构域突变会失衡这两个交叉β核心，为LC结构域的功能与功能障碍提供了意想不到的概念。意义声明：导致神经系统疾病的单氨基酸变化通常映射到低复杂度（LC）结构域的交叉β形成区域。迄今为止研究的所有此类突变均导致交叉β相互作用的亲合力增强。肉瘤融合（FUS）RNA结合蛋白的LC结构域包含三个能够形成不稳定交叉β相互作用的区域。在此，我们描述了肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）致病突变定位于FUS LC结构域所产生的令人困惑的效应，即显著削弱其形成三个交叉β相互作用之一的能力。理解这些突变如何助长FUS LC结构域的失控聚合，可能为LC结构域如何实现其正确生物学功能提供重要线索。
